input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28 selects New York law and grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, matching the preferred position exactly. There is no arbitration provision anywhere in the agreement (no hits for "arbitration") and no competing forum or governing-law language elsewhere, so no offshore seat or foreign venue risk arises despite the Vendor being a UK entity. The carve-out permitting temporary injunctive relief in another court is mutual and customary, and the pre-filing executive escalation in 28.2/28.3 does not delay urgent relief or limitations filings. No redline needed.
